tracks.title: Nachtschicht
tracks.about: Driving reese in the style of Dom & Roland, over a breathing pad on an F pedal.

tracks.title: Nebelhorn
tracks.about: A distorted foghorn bass calls across a rolling beat and a cold, wide pad.

tracks.title: Glasregen
tracks.about: Two-step liquid roller: glassy FM keys, a bell melody and rain made of glass taps.

tracks.title: Polarlicht
tracks.about: Chopped amen and a deep 808 sub under a choir pad, with a halftime breakdown.

tracks.title: Druckwelle
tracks.about: A loud, overdriven foghorn bass rolls under a supersaw hook made for the dancefloor.

tracks.title: Kernschmelze
tracks.about: A talking, wavefolded bass on an F sharp pedal, tight drums, metal stabs and lasers.

tracks.title: Starkstrom
tracks.about: A bouncing wub bass full of pitch bends, a hoover riff and air horns on the drop.

tracks.title: Tiefgarage
tracks.about: A sliding 808 and a fat, subby Reese roll as one bass through a dark, dripping car park.

tracks.title: Schwerkraft
tracks.about: A huge, slowly beating Reese rolls between heavy 808 booms that land every two bars.

tracks.title: Unterströmung
tracks.about: An 808 boom on every kick, a subby Reese rolling in the gaps, warm keys and chopped amens.

tracks.title: Seriennummer
tracks.mixer: Kick + snare, Bass, Arpeggio, Hats, Echo, Lead
tracks.about: A keygen anthem in FastTracker style: six channels, shimmering arpeggios, a heroic lead and its echo.

tracks.title: Rasterzeile
tracks.about: Three voices like the C64's SID chip: a PWM lead, a fast arpeggio, and one voice for bass and drums together.

tracks.title: Sternenfeld
tracks.about: A cheerful Amiga intro tune on four channels panned left-right-right-left, the drum channel turns into an echo in the break.
